hints.title: Parity Requirement and Greediness
hints.text: Replacing a bit with parity requires finding the smallest unused integer greater than current maximum with matching parity.

hints.title: 2D Grid Subproblem
hints.text: Let dp[i][j] be the minimum possible largest integer after placing the first i elements of nums1 and first j elements of nums2.

hints.title: Transition Parity Arithmetic
hints.text: If previous maximum has same parity as required number, add two; otherwise add one.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Recursive branching across both arrays causes exponential time complexity.
